test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)

question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Gazette'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is 3) **"gazette".**
 
• **In this context**, the government would issue a "gazette" notification to officially announce the creation of new districts.
 
• A **"gazette"** is an official journal or newspaper of a government, containing the authorized notices of its actions, such as legal notices, notifications, and other proclamations.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The blockade of the national highways leading to the Manipur valley, called by the United Naga Council (UNC), has been in place since 1 November. This has severely affected life in the State, with shortages and escalating costs of essential supplies such as fuel and food, even as demonetisation has exacerbated problems. Blockades like this are not new to Manipur. In 2011, there was initially a hundred-day- plus blockade enforced by Kuki-led groups, and countered later by Naga groups, which together had a debilitating effect on life in Manipur. This time the blockade is in place to oppose the creation of new districts by the OkramIbobi Singh government. On 9 December it issued a **gazette** notification for the creation of seven new districts by bifurcating seven (of a total of nine) districts. This decision had as much to do with long-pending demands — in particular, for a new Kuki-majority district to be carved out of the larger Senapati hill district — as with easing administrative access to (5)__________ areas from the district headquarters.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's consider the other options:
 
 
• **"Detail" **- The word "detail" as a noun typically refers to an individual feature, fact, or item. As a verb, it means to describe or list something carefully or thoroughly. Neither usage fits the context of an official government announcement.
 
• **"Lively" -** This adjective typically describes something that is full of life and energy, or an event or discussion that is exciting and full of activity. It does not fit in the context of an official government announcement.
 
• **"Live" **- This adjective describes something that is happening now, or a broadcast that is being transmitted at the time of speaking. It doesn't fit in the context of an official government announcement.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• सही शब्द का चयन करने के लिए वाक्य के संदर्भ को समझना महत्वपूर्ण है।
 
• चौथे रिक्त स्थान के संदर्भ में, नए जिलों के निर्माण के औपचारिक अधिसूचना की बात हो रही है।
 
 
• 'Detail' (विस्तार): इस संदर्भ में यह शब्द अनुपयोगी है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ होता है विवरण या विस्तार, जो अधिसूचना का प्रकार नहीं होता।
 
• 'Lively' (जीवंत): इस शब्द का अर्थ है जीवंत या ऊर्जावान, जिसका इस संदर्भ में कोई प्रासंगिकता नहीं है।
 
• 'Gazette' (राजपत्र): यह एक सरकारी अधिकारिक पत्रिका होती है जिसमें सरकार द्वारा किए गए निर्णयों, अधिसूचनाओं और कानूनों को शामिल किया जाता है। यह शब्द इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त है।
 
• 'Live' (प्रत्यक्ष): इसका अर्थ होता है प्रत्यक्ष या सीधा प्रसारण, जिसका इस संदर्भ में कोई प्रासंगिकता नहीं है।
 
 
 
• इस प्रकार, रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प **'गज़ेट' **है।
 
• इस प्रकार पूरा वाक्य होगा: 
 
 
• **"9 दिसंबर को उसने सात नए जिलों के निर्माण के लिए एक गज़ेट अधिसूचना जारी की।"**

The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Far-flung'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5 is 1) **"far-flung".**
 
• The term **"far-flung"** is used to describe places that are a great distance away or are very spread out.
 
• **In the context** of the sentence, it refers to areas in the new districts that are distant from the district headquarters.
 
• The **term suggests** that one of the reasons for the creation of new districts is to facilitate better administrative access to these
